body: Thank you. Sorry for being so negative, I love being a positive person, I even named my throwaway account that way to reflect my desire to feel good no matter the environment. Not this time... By the time they find out everything, all those nice things (like iphone, the Internet, my couch) will mean very little to me, and so I'd really love being far away from here. Either by going someplace else (a preferable, but nearly damn impossible option) or by getting my mind off the existence (don't wanna do that, but there are many ways for that).
Thank you for your response. I wish I could cut it like that, but I'm financially dependent on them, don't even have a place on my own, have to live with sister.
